services.title: Why Miss Clean
services.hourlyDesc: €18/hour, minimum 2 hours. We keep your home clean on a regular rhythm: kitchen, bathroom, dust and floors — to your list.
services.dryDesc: Visit fee from €40 + price by sofa, armchair, chair, mattress or rug. We clean on-site, on demand.
services.safeDesc: We use home-friendly products: no harsh smell, with careful formulas for fabrics and surfaces.
services.familyDesc: We choose cleaning methods so you can live at home calmly afterwards — with little ones and pets.
services.qualityDesc: We arrive on time, work carefully, and finish with a truly clean result — not a rushed showpiece.
services.deadline: Last order of the day: before 20:00
